channel.description: Latest articles from Hartford Business Journal (hartfordbusiness.com)

item.title: Senate GOP pitches deep cuts to CT tax and electric bills
item.description: Senate Republicans unveiled a $1.5 billion tax relief plan Tuesday, arguing the state’s flush coffers can afford far more than the one-time $500 million rebate Gov. Ned Lamont pitched last week.

item.title: 🔒 Spinnaker borrows $49M from Fannie Mae to refinance 150-unit Norwalk apartment building
item.description: Spinnaker Real Estate Partners has secured a $49.2 million loan from Fannie Mae to refinance a 150-unit apartment building in Norwalk completed in 2024. Commercial real estate lender Greystone said […]

item.title: CT building-products distributor to acquire Colorado company for $2.25B
item.description: Greenwich-based QXO Inc., a distributor of roofing, waterproofing and other building products, has agreed to acquire Colorado-based Kodiak Building Partners for $2.25 billion. QXO entered into an agreement to purchase […]

item.title: Hartford HealthCare partners with medtech firm to deploy AI against claim denials
item.description: Hartford HealthCare, one of the state’s largest healthcare systems, has formed a partnership with Milwaukee-based Sift Healthcare intended to reduce insurance claim denials and improve reimbursement accuracy by applying artificial intelligence earlier in the care process.

item.title: CT orthopaedic providers to combine through asset purchase
item.description: Two Connecticut-based orthopaedic providers are planning to combine operations through an asset purchase.

item.title: 🔒 New Haven-based biotech Precipio reports data breach
item.description: New Haven-based Precipio Inc., a cancer diagnostics company, recently reported to federal authorities a data breach that occurred in November and possibly affected more than 500 people.

item.title: CT bank plans Mansfield branch near UConn campus with $2M investment
item.description: Griswold-based Jewett City Savings Bank is seeking regulatory approval to open a new branch in Mansfield, a roughly $2 million investment that would mark the community lender’s eighth location.

item.title: 🔒 Cannabis company Curaleaf eyes Meriden retail location
item.description: Curaleaf Hartford Inc. is seeking approval to open a hybrid retail cannabis establishment in Meriden by taking over an existing commercial property.

item.title: PURA sets March 25 deadline for final decision on Aquarion sale
item.description: The Public Utilities Regulatory Authority has rejected Eversource Energy’s request for an expedited review of its proposed $2.4 billion sale of Aquarion Water Co., instead setting a March 25 deadline for a final decision, after a Superior Court judge remanded the case back to the state utility regulator.
